forbidden_shot.description: Redacted top-tier emergency impulse, possibly antimatter-catalyzed. Not the most powerful device they had — the most powerful device anyone was willing to admit to.
forbidden_shot.note: a mystery, not a datasheet — full antimatter spec killed by design (billiards-spec 'Killed ideas')

governing_rule: THE EXPLOSION IS NEVER THE EVENT. THE ORBIT AFTER THE EXPLOSION IS THE EVENT.

links.cascade: Target identification conflict; three conflicting designation records
links.note: Player may believe any two of the three records, not all three.
links.title: THE CASING

links.cascade: First real impulse — deliberately NOT a collision. Coupling efficiency is the unknown.
links.outcome: SUCCESS: YES. UNDERSTANDING: NO. Telemetry says the rock is not where the model predicted.
links.title: GARY

links.cascade: A miss becomes a gravity assist
links.outcome: a miss can be a better shot than a hit
links.title: THE BEAUTIFUL MISS

links.cascade: NO explosion — the chain couples to Mimas and its orbital phase changes. The Cassini Division's resonance signature changes before anyone sees Mimas leave. First forensic clue.
links.title: THE RING PROBLEM

links.cascade: Δv ledger starts diverging: reported 14.2 km/s / recovered 9.8 km/s — never resolve who lied.
links.title: THE CLEAN SHOT

links.cascade: No impact. Gravity quietly does the work.
links.note: The quietest and most terrifying link.
links.title: THE RESONANCE

links.cascade: Famous near-miss; correction turns catastrophe into success. Every successful shot makes the next shot harder.
links.title: TETHYS

links.cascade: Enormous Δv spent correcting cumulative error. The fuel lie becomes mechanical.
links.title: RHEA

links.cascade: Emergency correction only. Hyperion's chaotic rotation: can you exploit an object that refuses to behave like a billiard ball?
links.title: TITAN/HYPERION

links.cascade: Orbital elements change by a laughably small amount. Then the rings keep changing.
links.note: Remote momentum-transfer event — NOT an explosion on Mimas. UI strips to DISTANCE / TIME / IMPACT PROBABILITY / FIRE.
links.title: MIMAS

links.cascade: They did not invent a fuel-efficient way to move a moon. They invented a complicated way to make moving a moon someone else's problem.
links.title: THE RETURN
